item.title: Pull request #3009 created
item.description:
Upgrade to Gradle 9.8.2

This should resolve some warnings and support modern versions of Java. This PR also switches from Groovy to Kotlin for the build scripts. A few plugins have been added and there’s been a small amount of reorganization to simplify the tasks. Using plugins required "unpacking" some multi-step tasks into several top level tasks. These new tasks have names that begin with "_" in an attempt to indicate that they’re "internal".

(I have no idea if this will build successfully as a PR. The PR certainly isn't going to test the new build scripts.)

I've tried to carefully check that the build produces the same output. It appears to:

  • The index.html file in grammar-explorer is different because I added a meta charset element to it.
  • The top-level index file is different because I added a link to the grammar explorer.
  • The xslt-streaming.xml file present in the old build was an accident, I think.

(If you try to reproduce this comparison, set the Saxon version in gradle.properties to 12.9. I've updated to 12.10, but that changes all of the HTML files by a few bytes in the comment at the end.)

@Arithmeticus if you pull this branch you should be able to build with Java 25.

@michaelhkay and/or @ChristianGruen I'd appreciate it if you could smoke test this before we merge it and confirm that it "works for you".
